title: GlassWorm hides its loader in invisible Unicode inside Open VSX extensions
summary: Seven Open VSX extensions were republished on 17 October 2025 with a loader encoded in invisible Unicode variation selectors and private-use code points, so the malicious source rendered as blank space in editors. The payload harvested npm, GitHub and Git credentials, targeted cryptocurrency wallet extensions, and read its next command-and-control address from Solana transaction memos with Google Calendar as a fallback.
severity_rationale: Self-propagating credential theft and remote access in the extension marketplace that Cursor and other VS Code forks install from, using C2 that cannot be seized.
